material_passport.verification_scope: Author decision, source/protocol evidence, and the prospective public-data validation design were reviewed. No new training, evaluation, TEST access, score inspection, or benchmark admission occurred in AIS-R8-P2.

repro_lock.semantics: Prospective design lock only. Replay and result claims require AIS-R8-P3 execution and AIS-R8-P4 independent audit.

model_policy_audit.basis: The repository workspace exposes no authoritative model, reasoning-effort, service-tier, or speed telemetry; none was inferred from latency, prose, or prior task history.

author_decision.decision_source: Explicit author approval in the active central task after comparison of the strict-reproduction and relaxed public-data protocol-validation routes.
author_decision.scope_of_approval: Approve this pre-run scientific amendment and preparation of a fresh execution packet. This is not approval to execute an unspecified command.

amendment_rationale.problem: The pinned RecBole quick-start value NDCG@10=0.2768 is illustrative and lacks a formal source-bound result center, exact producer environment, run schedule, checkpoint artifact, and immutable evaluator receipt.
amendment_rationale.scientific_adjustment: Replace numeric-center reproduction as a mandatory Phase-1E criterion with a prospectively specified public-data protocol-validation lane. Retain strict provenance, leakage, evaluator, and namespace controls.
not_relaxed: same protocol and evaluator within the lane
fixed seed schedule and complete-run handling
immutable result artifacts and hash replay
preservation of negative or null outcomes
separation from controlled v5 evidence and the historical official-reproduction namespace
relaxed: a formal published numeric result center is no longer mandatory
matching or falling within a tolerance around 0.2768 is not an acceptance criterion
the proposed Wide-Deep-Apriori model is not required to run on MovieLens 100K because the dataset lacks the required basket, price, and e-commerce feature semantics
a model does not have to outperform its comparator for the protocol-validation lane to pass
scope limitations may remain at Phase-1E seal if no unresolved integrity, provenance, or leakage finding remains
prohibited_relaxations: relabeling illustrative or diagnostic results as official reproduction

layer_1_controlled_v5.scientific_role: Mechanism and ablation evidence for Rule-only, Deep-only, and Hybrid under a shared controlled protocol.

layer_2_public_ml100k.scientific_role: Validate that a pinned public recommendation framework, public dataset, explicit preprocessing rule, fixed protocol, and common evaluator can produce traceable baseline results.

evidence_architecture.combined_interpretation: The two layers are complementary but not numerically pooled. Public ML-100K evidence validates the benchmark procedure at limited scope; controlled v5 evidence studies the proposed mechanism. Neither layer alone establishes generalized Hybrid superiority.

public_validation_task.feedback_interpretation: Ratings of 4 or 5 are retained as positive implicit interactions; ratings below 4 are excluded before splitting.

split_contract.order_semantics: chronological ascending order by the retained event timestamp

candidate_and_relevance_contract.candidate_universe: all retained RecBole internal item tokens except the padding token
candidate_and_relevance_contract.seen_item_masking: all TRAIN-history items receive negative-infinity before top-k collection
candidate_and_relevance_contract.held_out_positive_definition: retained rating>=4 interactions assigned to validation or test
candidate_and_relevance_contract.training_negative_sampling: one uniform unseen item per positive BPR training event
candidate_and_relevance_contract.tie_handling: Pinned RecBole torch.topk implementation order; no raw-ID deterministic tie contract is claimed.
candidate_and_relevance_contract.tie_limitation: Popularity scores may contain ties. This is an explicit implementation-scoped limitation and must be reported, not silently repaired after output inspection.

minimum_registry.checkpoint_rule: final fitted popularity counts; no validation-selected learned checkpoint
maximum validation NDCG@10; larger is better

deferred_models.reason: Useful extension but not required to answer the minimal public-pipeline validation question; adding it would enlarge runtime and audit surface.
The minimal public lane already contains a non-learned sanity comparator and a learned reference model.
MovieLens 100K does not expose basket/co-purchase, price, or equivalent e-commerce semantics required for a faithful proposed-model test.

frozen_model_scope.scope_expansion_rule: Any added model requires a new prospective amendment before its TEST output is inspected.

evaluator.implementation: RecBole full-sort evaluator at the pinned source revision
evaluator.aggregation: RecBole user-level arithmetic mean at the requested cutoff

comparison.primary_comparison: RECBOLE_BPR minus RECBOLE_POP on NDCG@10 under the same frozen public-data protocol
comparison.bpr_summary: mean, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum across the three frozen BPR seeds
comparison.pop_summary: single deterministic point estimate under the same split and evaluator
comparison.delta_summary: descriptive BPR-seed deltas relative to the frozen Pop estimate
comparison.negative_or_null_outcome_policy: retain and report without changing dataset, metric, model registry, or seed schedule

reuse_allowed: hash-admitted GroupLens archive or atomic data bytes
an independently hash-locked dependency environment after packet admission
reuse_prohibited: v5 TEST artifacts as input to public-data configuration
historical ai-service checkpoints or benchmark numbers
required_before_execution: create a fresh immutable R8-P3 command packet
bind exact configuration files, runner files, environment lock, source, and data hashes
validate output root absence and capacity

protocol_validation_pass_requires: all one Pop and three BPR runs complete without seed substitution
every run binds the admitted source revision, dataset bytes, protocol, configuration, environment, command, and evaluator hashes
all models use the same rating filter, temporal split semantics, candidate universe, seen-item masking, cutoff, and evaluator implementation
all required metric values are finite and every run records cohort and denominator counts
no TRAIN/validation/TEST leakage or post-TEST configuration change is found
negative and null results are retained
AIS-R8-P4 fresh independent audit has no unresolved major integrity, provenance, or leakage finding
protocol_validation_fail_or_incomplete_i: any required run or frozen seed is missing
source, dataset, split, configuration, checkpoint, command, or evaluator identity cannot be replayed
model-specific preprocessing or evaluator drift makes the comparison invalid
TEST output is inspected before the protocol and model registry are frozen
runtime failure is retried in the same attempt root
an observed result causes a metric, filter, seed, model, or acceptance rule to change

requires: AIS-R8-P3 completes under the frozen packet
AIS-R8-P5 reconciles authoritative state without rewriting historical receipts
existing controlled-v5 limitations remain visible and no v5 TEST reopening occurs
a separate paper-admission decision identifies each admitted row and its evidence namespace
does_not_require: public-data validation of the proposed Hybrid architecture
removal of all scientific scope limitations

conditionally_allowed_after_p4_and_p5: The pinned recommendation pipeline was validated end to end on GroupLens MovieLens 100K under the prospectively specified protocol.
Pop and BPR observed metrics and descriptive seed variability within the exact PUBLIC_DATA_PROTOCOL_VALIDATION namespace.
The public-data lane supports procedural reproducibility at limited scope.
prohibited: RecBole's illustrative NDCG@10=0.2768 was officially reproduced.
The proposed Hybrid model was externally validated on MovieLens 100K.
Hybrid is superior to conventional models on public data.
Results from MovieLens 100K and v5 are directly numerically comparable.
The method is state of the art, production-valid, or generally effective for real e-commerce users.
A lack of BPR improvement over Pop invalidates the pipeline.
claim_policy.introduction_and_related_work: May describe motivation, design, evidence boundaries, and the prospectively selected public validation route. Empirical values and performance claims remain blocked until AIS-R8-P4 and AIS-R8-P5.

tls_and_acquisition_disposition.interpretation: The prior TLS observation is transport metadata. The admitted retained bytes may be used without claiming TLS success and without redownloading the dataset.

required_outputs: minimal Pop plus three-seed BPR runner

write_set.self_content_hash_semantics: The amendment is bound externally after commit by Git blob OID and raw SHA-256 to avoid self-reference.
post_write_checks_required: strict JSON parse with duplicate-key rejection
commit once on the current branch
